description: A mail app with a mailbox sidebar, a searchable message list, a reader and swipe actions on each row.
overview: A three-column mail screen built on `SplitView`: a sidebar of mailboxes (Inbox, Starred, Sent, Archive, Trash), a message list with a search field made from `InputGroup`, and a reader. On phones each column opens in turn. Rows use `Avatar` and support `SwipeActions` to archive or delete, and searching filters by sender, subject and body. The reader has Reply, Star, Archive and Delete buttons, and Reply opens a `Textarea`.
usage: Replace `INITIAL_MAIL` with your messages and `MAILBOXES` with your folders. Wire `onMailboxChange`, `onNewMessage`, `onReply`, `onStarChange`, `onArchive` and `onDelete` to your mail service.
